headline: Amazon launches redesigned Kindle lineup with new colors, thinner build
summary: Amazon introduced a new generation of Kindle e-readers, including the base Kindle, Paperwhite and Colorsoft, with fresh colors, thinner and lighter bodies, and bezel-free, flat-surface displays. The launch also included a new case accessory with built-in physical page-turn buttons, and the power button moved from the bottom edge to the side.
